_comment: Nudge copy. Write it the way you would say it to the person if you walked past their desk. That is the whole test: if you would not say the sentence out loud, it does not belong here. Hours are phrased the way people say them, days by name, and the ask is a question rather than an instruction with a colon.
_fields: Templates take {name} {problem} {cta} {streak_phrase} {link}. Everything else is assembled in send_nudges.py so the grammar agrees with the data: hours become spoken amounts, days become weekday names, singular and plural are chosen per person, and the problem clause is capitalised or not depending on where the template puts it.
_clauses: One sentence, ending in a full stop. Write the first word in whatever case reads naturally: send_nudges.py fixes the case to suit the template, and leaves a substituted weekday name alone rather than lowercasing it.
clause_hours_only: you're showing {logged} so far this week, out of {expected}.
clause_days_only: your hours are all in, they just went in a few days after the fact.
clause_both: {missing} {is_are} still empty, so you're at {logged} out of {expected} for the week.
clause_fallback: your hours are behind for this week.
_ctas: The ask, matched to the problem. Three different problems need three different asks: days that were never filled in, a total that is short, and hours that arrived days late. Telling someone in the third group to top it up reads as a message nobody checked before sending, because they have nothing to catch up on.
cta_missing_firm: Can you get {it_them} in before Friday? The week closes then.
cta_hours_light: Mind topping it up when you get a minute?
cta_hours_firm: Can you get it in before Friday? The week closes then.
cta_backfill_light: Can you log as you go this week? It only stays accurate that way.
cta_backfill_firm: Please log at the end of each day from now on. A week pieced together later isn't worth much.
_streaks: Firm template only. A streak crosses weeks, so a raw day number reads like nonsense in a weekly nudge.
streak_long: you've been behind every day for over a week now
weekly_digest_header: *Timesheet week of {week_of}*  ({scored} of {total} scored, team mean {mean})
weekly_digest_footer: Full JSON is attached to the workflow run. Paste it into a session for the read on patterns and the coaching notes.
failure_alert: :warning: Timesheet automation failed on {workflow}. Nobody was nudged on this run. Logs: {run_url}
